**True or False?**

Only one or two factors of production are needed to make any good or service.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Producing any good or service needs a **combination of all four** factors of production.

front_blocks.md: In countries with low labour costs, such as Thailand and Vietnam, clothing is often mass-produced using labour-intensive processes.

back_blocks.md: Where **labour costs are low**, there is little incentive to use machinery, so production stays **labour-intensive**.
